verdict.rationale: Synctera is a banking-as-a-service platform with an operations console, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an in-product AI assistant that can take delegated tasks. The llms.txt and OpenAPI probes only show machine-readable documentation, which is adjacent and not an assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
